title: The invitation that checked out
explanation: The fix gives the assistant a list it can test (the day, the time, the dish), and asks for the corrected note only. Options A and C ask for care, but a wish to be careful gives it nothing to check.
brokenPrompt: Write a short note inviting the neighbours to our street party on Saturday at 5 pm. Then check your work and improve it.
brokenOutput:
Dear neighbours,

Please join us for our street party on Sunday at 4 pm. Bring a dish to share!

I checked my work and it looks great. No changes needed.

diagnoses.text: The assistant should not check its own work.
'Check your work' gave it nothing to check against, so it said everything was fine.
The party invitation needed a joke.

wrongDiagnosisHint: Look at the day and the time in the answer. Did anything in the order tell the assistant to test them?
rightDiagnosisNote: 'Check your work' is a wish, not a test. With no list, the assistant had nothing to compare against, so the wrong day and time slipped through.

fixes.prompt: Write a short note inviting the neighbours to our street party on Saturday at 5 pm. Then triple-check your work and make it perfect.

Write a short note inviting the neighbours to our street party on Saturday at 5 pm. Then check it against this list: the day is Saturday, the time is 5 pm, and it asks people to bring a dish. Fix anything that fails and show me only the final note.
Write a short note inviting the neighbours to our street party on Saturday at 5 pm. Be very careful this time.

wrongFixHint: 'Triple-check' and 'be careful' are still wishes. Pick the one with a list the assistant can test.
fixedOutput:
Dear neighbours,

Please join us for our street party on Saturday at 5 pm. Bring a dish to share, and come hungry!
